settings.title: How do I become a member?
settings.text:
Click Here to Sign Up

Select the membership option you want!

Free tier will have a pop-up to confirm or create an account! Silver and Gold will add the product to your cart.

settings.title: Do I need to have an account with Grunt Style Rewards?
settings.text: Yes. You need a Grunt Style account to start earning rewards. When you join, we’ll prompt you to sign in or create one. No account = no perks.

settings.title: How does Grunt Style Rewards work?
settings.text:
Members must be signed in for perks to apply instantly online. At a retail store, share your email for perks to apply.

No minimum spend required.

Credits are valid for 90 days. Use them before they disappear.

Earn 5-20% in Credit on spend, Birthday Credit, and other perks!

Click here to see each tiers' perks!

settings.title: How does Free Shipping work?
settings.text:
If you’re a Silver or Gold member, you receive free shipping! Make sure you’re signed in and it automatically applies.

If you are part of the Member tier, you must have a subtotal of $75 to receive free shipping!

settings.title: How does the reward credit work?
settings.text:
After you sign in, you earn credits from every purchase!

* 5% for Members
* 20% for Gold

Don't forget, credits can be used online or in-store. They expire 90 days after earning.

settings.title: What purchases qualify for store credit?
settings.text:
You will earn store credit on most purchases. However, the following items are excluded and do not earn store credit:

- Donations made to the Grunt Style Foundation
- Gift card purchases
- Subscription or loyalty membership fees
- Custom products
- Package protection costs

Store credit is automatically applied to qualifying purchases and will be reflected in your account once your order is processed.

settings.title: Is everything eligible for credit redemption?
settings.text: No. Gift Cards, donations made to Grunt Style Foundation, third-party vendors, and package protection costs are not eligible for credit redemption.

settings.title: What kind of special access do I get?
settings.text: Gold and Silver Tiers receive access to member events, special pricing offers, early access to new products, and a members-only community! Member Tier receives access to member events, but if you want more, you need to upgrade!

settings.title: Is the membership fee a recurring charge?
settings.text:
Yes, if you signed up for the Gold tier! You are charged yearly! Upgrade your experience to Gold is $50!

If you need to cancel, then you will need to do so before your next charge date!

settings.title: How can I cancel my membership?
settings.text:
Cancel anytime by logging into your Member Portal or reaching out to our Customer Service team!

There are no cancellation fees, and cancelling your membership does not provide you with a refund, nor does it stop a pending charge. Your cancellation will go into effect for the following billing cycle.

Note: cancellation requests will go into effect at the end of the annual term. Annual Memberships are non-refundable.

settings.title: My benefits aren’t working. Why?
settings.text:
Make sure you’re signed into your Grunt Style account. Your perks only activate when you’re logged in. If you're in-store, provide your account email or phone number!

Note: Gift Cards, donations made to Grunt Style Foundation, third-party vendors, and package protection costs are not eligible for credit redemption.
